messages:
alex: FYI — nightly SAST started failing on main after KMS key rotation at 02:10 UTC. CI job logs show decryption errors.

alex: logs -> https://ci.redwood.example/builds/87231

maria: @alex can you paste the error snippet? wondering if it's keystore ACL or agent role

alex: ```Error: KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc123
at /opt/ci/runner/decrypt.js:45:13``` 

sam: @maria @alex that error usually means the service account used by scanner lost kms:Decrypt after the rotation; check keystore-policy and trust relationship

olivia: Oncall just saw a similar hit in staging 01:55 UTC — looks like the rotation script created a new key alias and didn't copy the grant for the scanner SA

maria: For mitigation, can we re-add the grant and re-run the nightly? Steps:
- create grant: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/scanner`
- update alias if needed

sam: Adding patch to terraform-keystore to include explicit grant resource for the scanner role in next PR. Will open now.

alex: Quick workaround: pinned SAST job to previous keystore via env var `KMS_KEY_ID=alias/keystore-old` — kicked off rerun, currently green :thumbsup:

secbot: [alert] KMS rotation detected in prod (rotation-id=rot-2026-03-20-0210). Related CI failures flagged. Link: https://sec.redwood.example/rotations/rot-2026-03-20-0210

olivia: We'll need an incident note: root cause=rotation grants not migrated; remediation=add grant + terraform change + retro

maria: Can one of you add a short postmortem to /incidents/ and assign owners? I'll take remediation and PR review.

sam: I opened PR #789 in terraform-keystore with grant resource and a unit test. tagging @olivia for prod deploy approval.

alex: Thanks—putting a short checklist in the incident note: reproduce, restore access, make infra change, add pre-rotation checklist to runbook, notify customers if any

olivia: small ask: can we add a pre-rotation automated test that runs a `kms:Decrypt` smoke check for all dependent service principals? low effort and prevents this

maria: Agreed. I'll add a GH Action that runs simulated decrypt against staging key before we alias rotation.

sam: I'll merge PR after CI passes; planning deploy at 09:00 UTC with oncall watching.

alex: closing loop — rerun succeeded, nightly SAST backlog cleared. We'll file a retro item for process + infra test. Thanks everyone.
